Exploitability_explanation: Vulnerability involves a sandbox escape in Jinja2 compiler. Thorough search of the Flask-Login codebase confirms no direct import or usage of jinja2. Any indirect usage via Flask does not expose the vulnerable compiler functions to user control.
Jinja2 sandbox bypass via str.format. API usage not found in Flask-Login. The library does not render user-provided templates or use Jinja2 filters in a way that would trigger this behavior.
Jinja2 sandbox breakout via |attr filter. API usage not found in active code paths. Score remains 1% as original assessment already correctly identified low exploitability.
Command injection in virtualenv activation scripts. virtualenv is a development/tox dependency and is not called by the Flask-Login library core code. Assessment is correct.

.netrc credential leakage in requests.utils.get_netrc_auth. Flask-Login does not import or use the requests library. Documentation (Sphinx) uses requests, but it's not part of the exploitable code surface.
DoS via unbounded decompression in urllib3. Flask-Login does not use urllib3 for network requests. No vulnerable API calls found.
Decompression bomb in urllib3 streaming API with redirects. API usage not found in Flask-Login codebase. Assessment within 20% tolerance.
Redirect bypass in Pyodide runtimes. Flask-Login does not use urllib3 or target Pyodide environments in a way that would invoke the vulnerable send_jspi_request function. Assessment correct.
TOCTOU race condition in filelock. This library is a tox/virtualenv dependency used for dev environment management and is not called by the application source code.
Path traversal in wheel unpack command. Flask-Login does not utilize the wheel library at runtime or for unpacking operations that would trigger chmod calls on arbitrary files.
DoS via quadratic complexity in idna.encode. No direct usage of the idna library found in the Flask-Login core source code.
Redirect bypass due to improper PoolManager initialization. urllib3 is not used by the library. Assessment correct.
Resource exhaustion in urllib3 streaming API. API usage not found. Original assessment correctly identified low risk.
TOCTOU race condition in virtualenv directory creation. Development tool not reachable from production code path.
TOCTOU race condition in filelock truncation. No usage of filelock in src/ directory. Development dependency risk only.
